name: tremplin
description: A modern, accessible, token-first frontend framework by Devciel.
author: Devciel

scripts.build:css: sass --style=expanded --source-map src/scss/tremplin.scss dist/css/tremplin.css && sass --style=compressed --source-map src/scss/tremplin.scss dist/css/tremplin.min.css && sass --style=expanded --source-map src/scss/tremplin-grid.scss dist/css/tremplin-grid.css && sass --style=compressed --source-map src/scss/tremplin-grid.scss dist/css/tremplin-grid.min.css && sass --style=expanded --source-map src/scss/tremplin-reboot.scss dist/css/tremplin-reboot.css && sass --style=compressed --source-map src/scss/tremplin-reboot.scss dist/css/tremplin-reboot.min.css && sass --style=expanded --source-map src/scss/tremplin-utilities.scss dist/css/tremplin-utilities.css && sass --style=compressed --source-map src/scss/tremplin-utilities.scss dist/css/tremplin-utilities.min.css && npm run build:css:assets
scripts.build: npm run check:no-legacy && npm run clean && npm run check:bootstrap && npm run build:api && npm run check:api && npm run build:css && npm run build:css:extensions && npm run build:js && npm run build:manifest && npm run check:size && npm run check:no-legacy
scripts.build:css:extensions: sass --style=expanded --source-map src/scss/extensions/index.scss dist/css/tremplin-extensions.css && sass --style=compressed --source-map src/scss/extensions/index.scss dist/css/tremplin-extensions.min.css
scripts.site:build: npm run check:docs-tokens && npm run site:prepare && astro build && pagefind --site site-dist && npm run check:no-legacy && npm run check:site-assets
scripts.build:site: npm run build && npm run site:build
scripts.test:sass:foundation: vitest run tests/breakpoint-api.test.ts tests/cascade-layers.test.ts tests/layout-defaults.test.ts tests/css-grid.test.ts tests/layout-generators.test.ts tests/responsive-layout.test.ts tests/spacing-defaults.test.ts --maxWorkers=2
scripts.test:sass:helpers: vitest run tests/detail-helpers.test.ts tests/stack-position-helpers.test.ts tests/hover-lift.test.ts tests/helpers-docs.test.ts --maxWorkers=2
scripts.test:sass:utility-api: vitest run tests/utility-generator.test.ts tests/utility-selectors.test.ts tests/utility-values.test.ts tests/utility-variants.test.ts tests/utility-api-docs.test.ts --maxWorkers=2
scripts.test:sass:utility-families: vitest run tests/utility-families.test.ts tests/color-role-utilities.test.ts tests/theme-utilities.test.ts tests/surface-utilities.test.ts tests/underline-utilities.test.ts tests/sizing-utilities.test.ts tests/utilities-docs.test.ts --maxWorkers=2
scripts.test:sass:mixed-docs: vitest run tests/styles.test.ts tests/structure.test.ts tests/metadata.test.ts tests/content-docs.test.ts tests/customize-docs.test.ts tests/layout-docs.test.ts --maxWorkers=2
scripts.typecheck:tests: node node_modules/typescript-bootstrap/bin/tsc -b tsconfig.core-types.json --force && node node_modules/typescript-bootstrap/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:bootstrap-integrations: npm run build:bootstrap-integrations && playwright test --config playwright.strict-integrations.config.ts
scripts.release: npm run check && npm run check:release && changeset publish
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:typecheck-boundaries && npm run build && npm run check:production-css && npm test && npm run test:js:fixtures:reference && npm run test:package && npm run test:server && npm run test:browser && npm run test:visual && npm run site:build && npm run test:site && npm run test:site-visual
